requirements.text: Riders must select an organization by its exact name, which is presented alphabetically; unknown names are rejected and require reselection.
requirements.source_quote: - Present organizations alphabetically and let riders select an organization by its exact name. Reject an unknown name and request another selection.

requirements.text: Accept a trip distance from 1.0 to 100.0 miles inclusive, including fractional miles, with no upper or lower bounds beyond this range.
requirements.source_quote: - Accept a trip distance from 1 through 100 miles inclusive, including fractional miles.
